race.comment: I'M LUCKY TWO (3) just missed the placings two runs back then improved last start but found one better over 1000m at this track, beaten 0.7 lengths after being in the firing line on the corner. Best figures measure up and is sure to run well. SHAHAR (7) was leading on the turn and fought on to finish fourth over 1000m at Sunshine Coast at her latest appearance. Has a high cruising speed and is sure to give backers a great sight. VESPER LYND (4) drifted well back and failed to finish it off last start when seventh, beaten 7 lengths, over 1000m at Dalby. Best figures measure up nicely so watch for a spike of form with the 2kg claim. RUMBLE TOWN (2) can run a nice race on return and isn't without a hope.
